map.牧草产量估算（亩产×面积） 使用指南: Forage yield estimation (per-mu x area) user guide
map.输入亩产鲜草量、种植面积与干物质率，自动估算鲜草、干草总产量及干草捆数。: Input per-mu fresh grass yield, planting area and dry-matter rate to auto-estimate fresh grass, dry hay total and hay bales.
map.鲜草总量 = 亩产 × 面积 × 单位系数；干草产量 = 鲜草总量 × 干物质率: Fresh grass total = per-mu yield x area x unit coefficient; dry hay yield = fresh grass total x dry-matter rate%; hay bales = dry hay yield / bale weight
map.单位系数把亩产换算为总量（kg/亩 直乘、t/ha × 0.0001、kg/㎡: The unit coefficient converts per-mu yield to total (kg/mu direct multiply, t/ha x 0.0001, kg/m^2 direct multiply by the corresponding area caliber). Fresh-grass total times dry-matter rate gives air-dry hay yield; divided by bale weight gives hay bales, and gives converted mu and hectare counts, for forage yield estimation and baling plans.
map.填写「单捆干草重（kg/捆，可选）」。: Fill in "dry hay bale weight (kg/bale, optional)".
map.总产量 = 测产亩产 × 面积 × 刈割次数系数。: Total yield = measured per-mu yield x area x mowing-frequency factor.
map.按鲜草或干草分别计量。: Measure fresh or dry grass separately.
map.用于草畜平衡与青贮计划。: For grass-livestock balance and silage planning.
map.：测产鲜草亩产 1500 kg，面积 30 亩，年刈 4 茬，则鲜草总产 = 1: : measured fresh grass per-mu 1500 kg, area 30 mu, 4 cuts/year, fresh grass total = 1500 x 30 x 4 = 180,000 kg = 180 t. Dry hay (water 20% vs fresh 70%) about 60 t.
map.连作障碍指数（土壤病原菌积累）估算: Continuous-cropping obstacle index (soil pathogen accumulation) estimation
map.鲜草和干草产量差这么多？: Why do fresh and dry grass yields differ so much?
map.鲜草含水 60%~80%，干草 15%~20%，『干物质』才是可比基数。交易与饲: Fresh grass moisture 60%-80%, dry hay 15%-20%; "dry matter" is the comparable base. Trade and feed recipes should use dry matter to avoid water misdirection.
map.看积温与降水，一般 3~5 茬。过度刈割伤根、降翌年产量，应在初花期前刈以兼顾产: Look at accumulated temperature and precipitation; generally 3-5 cuts. Over-mowing damages roots and lowers next-year yield; mow before early bloom to balance yield and quality.
